# `storage/AppSandbox.js`

> **Source:** `webgpu-os/storage/AppSandbox.js`

AppSandbox.js — Per-app isolated, AES-256-GCM encrypted IndexedDB storage. Each app runs in its own IndexedDB database:  os.sandbox.<appId> completely separate from the kernel database (os.kernel). ── Isolation guarantees ───────────────────────────────────────────────────── • Different IDB database per app  → app A can never query app B's IDB. • Legacy records use AES-256-GCM with a key derived from a public OS fingerprint and app ID. That separates namespaces but does not provide secret-key confidentiality against someone who knows that fingerprint. • Enrolled private collections use openPagedStore(), backed by the kernel operator vault's random secret root, purpose keys and verified recovery. Collection migrations keep the legacy reader until copy verification and activation complete; the legacy key is never treated as a vault secret. ── API ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── const sb = new AppSandbox('os.calculator', cryptoDriver, { storage, operatorScope, operatorContext, }); await sb.init(); await sb.set('lastResult', 42);       // encrypt + store const v = await sb.get('lastResult'); // decrypt + return (null if missing) const keys = await sb.list();         // returns key names (not values) await sb.delete('lastResult'); await sb.clear();                     // wipe all of this app's data const info = sb.info();               // { appId, dbName, encrypted: true } ── Syscall surface (apps see syscalls.sandbox.*) ──────────────────────────── Created by createSandboxSyscalls(sandbox) exported below. Apps never receive a reference to AppSandbox directly.

## Functions

### `createSandboxSyscalls(sandbox)`

Wrap an AppSandbox as the `syscalls.sandbox` namespace for an app. Apps receive this — they never get a reference to the AppSandbox itself. Usage in app code: await syscalls.sandbox.set('prefs', { theme: 'dark' }); const p = await syscalls.sandbox.get('prefs'); const keys = await syscalls.sandbox.list(); await syscalls.sandbox.delete('prefs'); await syscalls.sandbox.clear(); const { appId, dbName, encrypted } = syscalls.sandbox.info();
